subject: CTRL
source_sentence: Class- conditional language models (CC-LMs), as the Conditional Transformer Language (CTRL) model , train or fine-tune the weights θ of a single neural model directly for controllable generation , by appending a control code in the beginning of a training sequence.

subject: Human Evaluation
source_sentence: Since automatic metrics can be biased and may not faithfully represent the human judgement, we conduct a human evaluation to compare with the results obtained through oracles and confirm the results and the relevance of automatic metrics.
title: PPL-MCTS: Constrained Textual Generation Through Discriminator-Guided MCTS Decoding
